name: SONATSouth Sys Expansion I Phase 1

values.SegmentName: South System Expansion I Project, Phase 1

researcher_notes: EIA lists this as a completed expansion by Southern Natural Gas, finished in June 2002. It adds 39 miles of pipe, 24 and 36 inch, across Mississippi, Alabama and Georgia, with 139.9 MMcf/d of added capacity and a cost of 53.6 million dollars. The FERC docket is CP00-233. Source is the August 2026 EIA release, sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), Excel row 237; the URL verifier found the project name in it. The tracker has only the parent system row P0252 and the SSE4 row P7855, so no existing row matches. The tracker already carries completed expansions as their own rows, and 39 miles is about 63 km, above the 25 km minimum. Only EIA was found, so confidence is medium. No FERC filing was opened to pair with it. Start and end states are the first and last states in the EIA list. Exact endpoints and the route were not found. Row naming follows the parent system name and an assumed segment name, so a reviewer should confirm it. Owner spelling is as EIA gives it and no legal form was confirmed.
